card.name: Decimal digit or half after a number
card.fires_on: The digit after a decimal point in a number such as 10.5 or 26.2, and the word half in 'two and a half'. It fires where a quantity is followed by a unit such as miles, mL or years.

modes.label: Decimal digit
modes.description: The digit right after the decimal point, mostly after 10, before a unit.
